t: The Essentials Caution People At Work A-frame sign is a vital safety tool, clearly indicating active work zones and potential hazards across various environments. Measuring 600mm x 290mm, this highly visible yellow sign is essential for electricians, plumbers, and builders working on installations, repairs, or maintenance. Constructed from durable 2mm polypropylene, it offers a robust yet lightweight design for quick setup and effortless repositioning on site. The foldable A-frame structure ensures easy transport and efficient storage, providing clear warning to maintain a safe working environment for all.
b: Bright Yellow Colour for Clear Warning
